mapper.sql: leave_type_id, type_code, type_name, unit_mode, pay_policy, paid_ratio, minutes_per_day, balance_required, attachment_required, attachment_threshold_minutes, min_minutes, step_minutes, max_minutes_per_request, allow_cross_day, approval_required, sort_no, status, row_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark
mapper.select: select from oa_attendance_leave_type where leave_type_id=#{leaveTypeId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into oa_attendance_leave_type ( type_code, type_name, unit_mode, pay_policy, paid_ratio, minutes_per_day, balance_required, attachment_required, attachment_threshold_minutes, min_minutes, step_minutes, max_minutes_per_request, allow_cross_day, approval_required, sort_no, status, row_version, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{typeCode}, #{typeName}, #{unitMode}, #{payPolicy}, #{paidRatio}, #{minutesPerDay}, #{balanceRequired}, #{attachmentRequired}, #{attachmentThresholdMinutes}, #{minMinutes}, #{stepMinutes}, #{maxMinutesPerRequest}, #{allowCrossDay}, #{approvalRequired}, #{sortNo}, #{status}, 0, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: update oa_attendance_leave_type set type_name = #{typeName}, unit_mode = #{unitMode}, pay_policy = #{payPolicy}, paid_ratio = #{paidRatio}, minutes_per_day=#{minutesPerDay}, balance_required = #{balanceRequired}, attachment_required = #{attachmentRequired}, attachment_threshold_minutes = #{attachmentThresholdMinutes}, min_minutes = #{minMinutes}, step_minutes = #{stepMinutes}, max_minutes_per_request = #{maxMinutesPerRequest}, allow_cross_day = #{allowCrossDay}, approval_required = #{approvalRequired}, sort_no = #{sortNo}, row_version = row_version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now(), remark = #{remark} where leave_type_id = #{leaveTypeId} and row_version = #{rowVersion}
mapper.select: select u.nick_name from sys_user u join sys_user_profile p on p.user_id = u.user_id join sys_dept target_dept on target_dept.dept_id = #{shopId} where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and p.employee_status in ('试用', '正式', '在职', '待离职') and target_dept.status = '0' and target_dept.del_flag = '0' and target_dept.dept_type = 'STORE' and ( exists ( select 1 from sys_dept employee_dept where employee_dept.dept_id = u.dept_id and employee_dept.status = '0' and employee_dept.del_flag = '0' and (employee_dept.dept_id = target_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(target_dept.dept_id, employee_dept.ancestors)) ) or exists ( select 1 from sys_user_shop us where us.user_id = u.user_id and us.dept_id = target_dept.dept_id ) ) limit 1
mapper.sql: select r.leave_request_id, r.leave_request_no, r.client_request_id, r.client_request_fingerprint, r.user_id, r.user_name, r.shop_id, r.leave_type_id, t.type_code leave_type_code, t.type_name leave_type_name, r.start_time, r.end_time, r.total_minutes,r.requested_days,r.quota_policy_json,r.quota_units,r.quota_status, r.reason, r.status, r.business_round, r.approval_instance_id, r.row_version, r.last_approval_event_key, r.submitted_at, r.approved_at, r.rejected_at, r.cancelled_at, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, (select count(*) from oa_attendance_leave_attachment a where a.leave_request_id = r.leave_request_id) attachment_count from oa_attendance_leave_request r join oa_attendance_leave_type t on t.leave_type_id = r.leave_type_id
mapper.insert: insert into oa_attendance_leave_request ( leave_request_no, client_request_id, client_request_fingerprint, user_id, user_name, shop_id, leave_type_id, start_time, end_time, total_minutes, requested_days, quota_policy_json, quota_units, quota_status, reason, status, business_round, approval_instance_id, row_version, last_approval_event_key, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{leaveRequestNo}, #{clientRequestId}, #{clientRequestFingerprint}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{shopId}, #{leaveTypeId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{totalMinutes}, #{requestedDays}, #{quotaPolicyJson}, #{quotaUnits}, #{quotaStatus}, #{reason}, #{status}, 0, null, 0, null, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark} )
mapper.select: where r.leave_request_id = #{leaveRequestId}
where r.leave_request_id = #{leaveRequestId} for update

select schedule_id scheduleId, shop_id shopId, business_date businessDate, timestamp(business_date, start_time_snapshot) scheduleStart, timestamp( case when cross_day_snapshot = 1 or end_time_snapshot <= start_time_snapshot then date_add(business_date, interval 1 day) else business_date end, end_time_snapshot) scheduleEnd from oa_attendance_schedule where user_id = #{userId} and shop_id = #{shopId} and business_date between date_sub(#{dateFrom}, interval 1 day) and #{dateTo} and status in ('PUBLISHED', 'CHANGED') order by business_date, schedule_id

select coalesce(sum(timestampdiff(minute, greatest(#{startTime}, date_add( timestamp(s.business_date, '00:00:00'), interval ss.start_minute_offset minute)), least(#{endTime}, date_add( timestamp(s.business_date, '00:00:00'), interval ss.end_minute_offset minute)))), 0) from oa_attendance_schedule s join oa_attendance_schedule_segment_snapshot ss on ss.schedule_id = s.schedule_id and ss.segment_type = 'WORK' where s.user_id = #{userId} and s.shop_id = #{shopId} and s.status in ('PUBLISHED', 'CHANGED') and s.business_date between date_sub(date(#{startTime}), interval 1 day) and date(#{endTime}) and date_add(timestamp(s.business_date, '00:00:00'), interval ss.start_minute_offset minute) < #{endTime} and date_add(timestamp(s.business_date, '00:00:00'), interval ss.end_minute_offset minute) > #{startTime}
mapper.insert: insert into oa_attendance_leave_segment ( leave_request_id, business_date, start_time, end_time, total_minutes, paid_minutes, unpaid_minutes, schedule_id, segment_status, create_time ) values ( #{leaveRequestId}, #{businessDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{totalMinutes}, #{paidMinutes}, #{unpaidMinutes}, #{scheduleId}, #{segmentStatus}, now() )
mapper.select: select leave_segment_id leaveSegmentId, leave_request_id leaveRequestId, business_date businessDate, start_time startTime, end_time endTime, total_minutes totalMinutes, paid_minutes paidMinutes, unpaid_minutes unpaidMinutes, schedule_id scheduleId, segment_status segmentStatus, create_time createTime from oa_attendance_leave_segment where leave_request_id = #{leaveRequestId} order by business_date, start_time, leave_segment_id

mapper.insert: insert into oa_attendance_leave_attachment ( leave_request_id, original_name, storage_path, content_type, file_extension, file_size, sha256, uploaded_by, create_time ) values ( #{leaveRequestId}, #{originalName}, #{storagePath}, #{contentType}, #{fileExtension}, #{fileSize}, #{sha256}, #{uploadedBy}, now() )
mapper.select: select from oa_attendance_leave_attachment where leave_request_id = #{leaveRequestId} and sha256 = #{sha256} limit 1

mapper.update: update oa_attendance_leave_request set status = 'SUBMITTING', quota_status=CASE WHEN quota_policy_json IS NULL THEN quota_status WHEN quota_units IS NULL THEN 'NOT_REQUIRED' ELSE 'RESERVED' END, business_round = #{businessRound}, approval_instance_id = null, last_approval_event_key = null, submitted_at = now(), row_version = row_version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where leave_request_id = #{leaveRequestId} and status = #{expectedStatus} and row_version = #{expectedVersion}

update oa_attendance_day_result d join oa_attendance_schedule s on s.schedule_id = d.schedule_id join oa_attendance_leave_request r on r.leave_request_id = #{leaveRequestId} and r.user_id = s.user_id and r.shop_id = s.shop_id set d.settled_at = null, d.result_status = 'PENDING', d.exception_codes = 'LEAVE_REQUEST_REVIEW_REQUIRED', d.row_version = d.row_version + 1, d.calculated_at = now(), d.update_by = #{updateBy}, d.update_time = now() where s.status in ('PUBLISHED', 'CHANGED') and timestamp(s.business_date, s.start_time_snapshot) < r.end_time and timestamp( case when s.cross_day_snapshot = 1 then date_add(s.business_date, interval 1 day) else s.business_date end, s.end_time_snapshot) > r.start_time

mapper.insert: insert ignore into oa_attendance_leave_approval_start_outbox ( leave_request_id, business_round, idempotency_key, request_json, status, attempt_count, next_retry_at, request_row_version, row_version, create_by, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{leaveRequestId}, #{businessRound}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestJson}, #{status}, 0, null, #{requestRowVersion}, 0, #{createBy}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: select from oa_attendance_leave_approval_start_outbox where outbox_id = #{outboxId} for update

select from oa_attendance_leave_approval_start_outbox where (status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY') and (next_retry_at is null or next_retry_at <= #{dueAt})) or status = 'REMOTE_SUCCEEDED' or (status = 'PROCESSING' and claimed_at <= #{staleClaimedBefore}) order by case status when 'REMOTE_SUCCEEDED' then 0 when 'PROCESSING' then 1 when 'RETRY' then 2 else 3 end, coalesce(next_retry_at, create_time), outbox_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update oa_attendance_leave_approval_start_outbox set status = 'REMOTE_SUCCEEDED', remote_instance_id = #{remoteInstanceId}, remote_status = #{remoteStatus}, remote_business_round = #{remoteBusinessRound}, remote_succeeded_at = now(), last_http_status = #{lastHttpStatus}, last_error_code = null, last_error = null, claim_token = null, claimed_at = null, row_version = row_version + 1, update_time = now() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = #{expectedStatus} and row_version = #{expectedVersion}
